title: When the Songbook Breaks
author: Coral Eriksen
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
